## Services

- [Website Development](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/website-development.html): Website development company in India, the USA and the UAE. Fast, mobile-first business websites that bring enquiries. Free demo before you pay; you own the domain, hosting and code.
- [App Development](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/app-development.html): Android and iOS app development company in India, the USA and the UAE. Apps with backend and admin panel, from idea to Play Store and App Store. Milestone payments, you own the code.
- [iOS App Development](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/ios-app-development.html): iOS app development in India, the USA and the UAE. Native and cross-platform iPhone and iPad apps with backend, admin panel and App Store release. Clickable demo first; you own the code.
- [Software Development](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/software-development.html): Custom software development in India, the USA and the UAE: web apps, CRMs, dashboards, admin panels and API integrations built around how your business works. You own the code.
- [CRM Development](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/crm-development.html): Custom CRM development in India, the USA and the UAE. Pipelines, follow-ups, WhatsApp and reports built around your sales process. Clickable demo first; you own the data and the code.
- [Desktop Software Development](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/desktop-software-development.html): Desktop and PC software development in India, the USA and the UAE. Windows business applications for billing, inventory, offline work and internal tools, with a demo first and source code you own.
- [LMS Development](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/lms-development.html): Custom LMS development in India, the USA and the UAE. Course websites, student logins, payments, live classes and certificates for coaches, institutes and corporates. Demo first; you own the code.
- [E-commerce Development](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/ecommerce-development.html): E-commerce website development in India, the USA and the UAE: WooCommerce and custom online stores with payments, COD, shipping and a fast mobile checkout. Free demo first.
- [UI/UX Design](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/ui-ux-design.html): UI/UX design services in India, the USA and the UAE: conversion-focused website and mobile app design, wireframes, high-fidelity screens and clickable prototypes.
- [Digital Marketing](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/digital-marketing.html): Digital marketing services in India, the USA and the UAE: SEO, GEO and AEO, social media, Google Ads, Meta Ads and AI-powered campaigns, with honest reporting and no fake promises.
- [SEO Services](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/seo-services.html): SEO services in India, the USA and the UAE: technical SEO, on-page SEO, local SEO and content that help customers find you on Google. Honest monthly reporting, no fake ranking guarantees.
- [GEO & AEO Services](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/geo-aeo-services.html): GEO and AEO services in India, the USA and the UAE: generative engine optimisation and answer engine optimisation so your business can be cited in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity.
- [Google Ads Management](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/google-ads-management.html): Google Ads management in India, the USA and the UAE. Search, Performance Max and YouTube campaigns with conversion tracking, honest reporting and an ad account you own. No fake lead guarantees.

- [AI Ads Marketing](https://akshaidev69.github.io/anmolgupta.github.io/ai-ads-marketing.html): AI-powered ads marketing in India, the USA and the UAE. Smarter Google and Meta campaigns: AI creatives, testing and bidding, with human strategy, tracking and reports. Ad accounts stay in your name.
